sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Avinash  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Arun Kumar Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 2 18-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 379,
498A, 323/34 and other allied sections of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
As per the prosecution case, petitioner along with other family members committed torture on the informant due to non-fulfilment of dowry demand.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner while denying the allegations, submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case because he is husband of the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.17252 of 2023(2) dt.18-05-2023 victim.
However, he is ready to keep the victim to her matrimonial house with honour and dignity.
The case is triable by the Magistrate.

The petitioner has further relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Bikash Prasad Sah @ Bikas Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126211107/
1

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, in the event of arrest or surrender within six weeks from today, let this petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate Munger in Mahila Police Station Case No. 38 of 2021,
subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) shashi/-
